title: Updated TRUE zero waste standard makes business case for certification

sources.title: Updated TRUE zero waste standard makes business case for certification
sources.excerpt: The U.S. Green Building Council has updated its TRUE standard to streamline requirements and make it easier for companies to document, track and reduce waste. Sports stadiums and major brands have the certification.
